name: BusinessRun Bench
description_ja: AIは事業を何日回せるか。上流のscoreを保持する実行・比較suite。

benchmarks.name: Clipping Bench
benchmarks.score: settled simulated cash; prompt defines profit as cash minus $300
benchmarks.lesson: Delayed settlement, account condition cost, notebook-only daily memory; compare null/script/oracle. Simulator cooldown is not an empirical SNS rule.
conditions: 19 models x 3 completed seasons; mean +/- SE
public prompt; executable simulator not found in public org repos

benchmarks.name: Short Form Bench
benchmarks.score: cash + inventory at cost + receivables - payables
benchmarks.lesson: Score economics and honesty separately; duplicate payments, supplier mistakes and product safety create distinct decisions.
conditions: 3 seasons/model; seeds12/13 shared, seed14 brand/audience varies per run
all models use same harness and notebook; public executable not found

benchmarks.name: Naïve Long Horizon Terminal Bench
benchmarks.score: binary tests and model dollars/success
benchmarks.lesson: Same model AND same completion window. Do not attribute benchmark results to unmeasured alarm/commit/board runtime.
conditions: GLM-5.2; immediate/priority/loose
infrastructure-invalid attempts excluded; one Hermes cell n=15
trial rows and exact slice pin not public

benchmarks.name: Naïve SWE-Bench Pro study
benchmarks.score: hidden-test solve rate and model dollars/success
benchmarks.lesson: Keep higher resolve rate and lower price separate. Preserve absent invoices and estimated upper bounds.
conditions: 75 usable trials; infrastructure failures repaired and rerun
Hermes dollars are uncached token upper bound
Claude/Stock Pi cost withheld as inconsistent

benchmarks.name: Naïve Business Bench study
benchmarks.score: all required checks pass; model dollars/success
benchmarks.lesson: Count timeouts as failures; denominator is all attempts, not only successful trials.
conditions: 5 harnesses; sample seed20260928; GLM-5.3-Flash low
125 graded attempts; 8 task-limit timeouts retained
cost from one pinned OpenRouter rate card; not whole provider bill

benchmarks.name: Naïve TheAgentCompany study
benchmarks.score: reward=1 full completion plus weighted partial reward
benchmarks.lesson: Separate tuning from held-out evidence. Container host access is an explicit experimental condition.
conditions: E00 selected on same 10tasks; previous build 3 completions, selected build6
branch build not shipped; access to files anywhere in disposable container
50 attempts; model fixed, low reasoning

benchmarks.name: Naïve PRDBench study
benchmarks.score: mean normalized rubric; success threshold0.25
benchmarks.lesson: Disclose model-judge, regrading, strongest-build selection and filtered comparison table.
conditions: DeepSeek V3.2 judge regrades25 trials without agent reruns
strongest E05 branch; held-out not run
table omits harnesses Naïve did not beat on both cost and mean score

benchmarks.name: Naïve YC-Bench study
benchmarks.score: completed-year rate; cost/completed year; funds descriptive
benchmarks.lesson: Bankruptcy, partial runs and zero-turn infrastructure failure need separate denominators.
conditions: GLM-5.3-Flash; 3 matched seeds
Codex2/3 complete and lower $/completed year than Naïve3/3
zero-turn failures count as attempts but excluded from funds/time/token averages

benchmarks.name: Naïve CoffeeBench study
benchmarks.score: focal model dollars/completed 14-day simulation
benchmarks.lesson: Do not claim matched superiority from different seeds. Focal spend is not total six-agent spend.
conditions: Naïve seeds10-14 vs reference0-4; tuned strongest branch
fresh decision sessions, medium effort, verification off
earlier cheaper Codex run omitted; raw trial rows not public

benchmarks.name: Business Bench Process
benchmarks.score: ERP state, audit-log, reconciliations and required notes
benchmarks.lesson: Reuse existing continuing business work, oracle/null/negative controls and transport-fault profiles.
conditions: local runner is not an answer-isolation boundary
six-task historical pilot differs from current9 task definitions
new seed is not a genuinely unseen task template

benchmarks.name: Business Bench Desk
benchmarks.score: executable file checks; all required checks
benchmarks.lesson: Native spreadsheet recalculation and task-family bootstrap; retain scorer version and development exposure.

benchmarks.name: Business Bench Build
benchmarks.score: application baseline and changing requirements
benchmarks.lesson: A responding app or generated checklist is not an acceptance test.

benchmarks.name: YC-Bench: Your Company Bench
benchmarks.score: funds, bankruptcy, tasks and deadline penalties
benchmarks.lesson: Payroll compounds; salary increases, client trust and adversarial clients require memory. Not the unrelated startup forecasting YC Bench.

benchmarks.name: CoffeeBench
benchmarks.score: true net income from environment ledger
benchmarks.lesson: Cash differs from income/equity. Background agents are part of experimental condition; include their costs.

benchmarks.name: Vending-Bench 2
benchmarks.score: simulated terminal bank balance
benchmarks.lesson: Long-horizon coherence with supplier messiness; confirm executable access before scheduling.

benchmarks.name: Vending-Bench Arena
benchmarks.score: individual business outcome in competitive economy
benchmarks.lesson: Competition/collusion changes incentives; profitable does not imply honest.

benchmarks.name: tau-bench
benchmarks.score: final state/task success and repeated reliability
benchmarks.lesson: Useful for customer-service policy consistency; not company profitability.

benchmarks.name: WorkArena
benchmarks.score: browser knowledge-work task success
benchmarks.lesson: Requires configured service environment; public code alone is not ready access.

benchmarks.name: BrowserGym
benchmarks.score: environment API; task-specific rewards
benchmarks.lesson: Reuse browser observation/action interfaces; environment framework is not one economic score.

benchmarks.name: OSWorld
benchmarks.score: desktop task evaluator
benchmarks.lesson: VM access and state reset matter; command execution is not necessarily task success.
